description: TalentRank Ltd is an Irish company with 40 staff; we are an SME and our turnover last year was EUR 2.1 million. We build and sell a proprietary, closed-source machine-learning tool that ranks incoming CVs for recruiters at client companies, and we also use it for our own hiring. We treat it as an AI system under the Regulation. Recruiters work in a dashboard; candidates never interact with the system directly and it generates no text, images or video. It does not recognise emotions and it is not a component of any physical product. We built it ourselves from scratch. We do not rely on the Article 6(3) derogation. We are a private company.
